title: TEND solver-side allow-list
description: Machine-readable solver boundary contract for SMART schema-less agentic stages (single LLM backbone / 4 stages; ① perception mode = concurrent probes, ②③④ cognition mode; ④ uses per-stage execution-guided decoding, no retrieval). Authoritative prose in proposals/06_solution_design.md.
disabled_operator_note: Six disabled operators per 01 §01-2-2; AST filter must reject all six plus $$NOW before submission.
train_json_access: forbidden:** (solver does not use train.json — neither training labels nor retrieval corpus, §06-2-0; NoSQL-native idioms come from frozen LLM knowledge + 06 §06-2-3 strategy table)

witness_sample_limit.note: ≤ K docs/collection may enter any prompt; the query_realization executor runs PER-STAGE prefix execution on the solver's full LOCAL replica (variant-stratified, for cross-variant debug) — the K limit caps prompt-injected samples, not local execution data volume.

sets.C_construction_pool: Construction Agent LLM model IDs used by {QPS, MS, MUT, PV, NLP, RTV, NNC, RA}

four_party_disjointness.s_solver_scope_note: A single shared LLM backbone runs all 4 stages (perception mode for ①, cognition mode for ②③④). Per-stage execution-guided decoding, AST filter and deterministic reduce use NO model — not counted. ① perception probes MAY optionally run on a same-family small model (cost optimization); if so, that model is counted in S_solver.

frozen_panel_note: frozen_panels.* is the release-pinned 4-panel manifest used for solver disjointness; non-stub evaluation fails closed if any required panel is missing or empty.

shape_comprehension.owner_agent: LLM Agent · perception mode (concurrent map-reduce probes; may use a same-family small model when cost-sensitive)
shape_comprehension.note: __variants is the authoritative shape contract; no data sampling here. Undeclared real-data shapes are caught downstream via the query_realization → shape_comprehension loop.

readable: mongodb_data/<db_id>.json (≤ K docs per collection into prompt)

query_realization.owner_agent: LLM Agent · cognition mode (generation + self-debug fused; executor is an inline tool)
readable: mongodb_data/<db_id>.json (local replica; variant-stratified execution; ≤ K docs/collection into prompt)
query_realization.execution_mode: per_stage_prefix_execution (each prefix [stage_1..stage_k] executed on a variant-stratified LOCAL sample; checkpoint at every stage boundary; §06-2-5)

mongo_executor.description: Per-Stage Execution-Guided Decoding: an inline ④ execution-guidance tool (NOT a stage, NOT an agent). An MQL aggregation pipeline is an ordered stage sequence; any prefix [stage_1..stage_k] is itself a legal executable pipeline, so ④ executes each growing prefix on a variant-stratified LOCAL sample and sets a checkpoint at every stage boundary. Authoritative prose in 06 §06-2-5.
mongo_executor.reuses: SMART/utils/mongosh_exec.py (execute_query already runs an arbitrary query string; prefix execution only closes `])` + .toArray())
mongo_executor.on_checkpoint_hit: locate by stage_index, then route via query_realization.feedback_routing to {heterogeneity_planning|intent_formalization|shape_comprehension}
mongo_executor.execution_scope: LOCAL replica only (never evaluator gold); variant-stratified; NOT subject to the witness K limit (K caps prompt-injected samples, not local execution data volume, §06-4-4.2)
